title: Join us. End it.
slide_intent: Introduce the brand through a person and an invitation. The reader can encounter the people at the center of the work before reading the guidelines.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can give its call to action a human setting through a portrait and a visible conversation.
demonstration: A photograph fills the cover. The wordmark appears at upper left and a cyan drawn line brackets a two-line pink invitation on black.
practical_value: Choose a crop with room for both the person’s face and the invitation. Place the headline where it can be read without covering the face.

content_islands.name: Portrait
content_islands.spec: Fill the landscape frame with the conversation. Keep the sharply focused face on the right.

content_islands.name: Identity and invitation
content_islands.spec: Place the small dark logo at upper left. Group the headline, cyan gesture and January 2021 edition line in the lower-left field.
